notes.title: Preview of "City Internship at VR Driving School"
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841017/026e5aef306cc3506cb9ade8b0e8ef2ae16abd75.png[/img]
In order to help users improve their urban driving skills and enhance their awareness of traffic regulations and safety, and reduce bad driving habits, VR Driving School has developed the "Urban Internship" module, which covers various types of roads and intersections such as road conditions, overpasses, and highways in different cities. Welcome to follow, please stay tuned.
